board.en: User questions, answers and replies are displayed in their original language and are not sent to an external translation service.
board.zh-CN: 用户的问题、回答与回复均按原文显示，不会发送到外部翻译服务。

friends.en: Friend posts are shared across all language pages and displayed in their original language.
friends.zh-CN: 好友招募内容在所有语言页面共用，并按原文显示。

privacy.en: This translation is provided for convenience. The Japanese version is the original policy text.
privacy.zh-CN: 本译文仅为方便阅读而提供，日文版为政策原文。

consult.en: This beta tool is not a generative-AI chatbot. It answers only from local JSON data stored on this site.
consult.zh-CN: 此 beta 工具并非生成式 AI 聊天机器人，仅根据本站的本地 JSON 数据回答。
